fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that a person offering to buy an item listed online asked the complainant to approve a UPI request, following which Rs. 45,000 was withdrawn. The matter was brought to Coimbatore Town PS on 2025-07-28, while the incident was placed on 2025-07-27 at about 15:10. The complaint refers to Sathish Subramani, a person who arranged the contact, reachable on 9000000429. A second person, Hariharan Prakash (9000000017), was also mentioned as possibly present. Hariharan Babu (mobile 9000000154) was named as a possible person of interest. A witness, Babu Rajan, reachable on 9000000365, was mentioned in the complaint. Transactions from the account SYN-ACC-100052, held by the complainant, were referred to in the complaint. The complainant mentioned transaction records.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Fraudulent QR code allegedly shared under the pretext of a refund.
fields.Keywords: UPI fraud, online payment, mobile number, suspect, afternoon, bank account, college road, witness
